Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: final production background for a 2D scavenging game set inside a decaying retro-futurist space station. Make ONE original, full-bleed landscape illustration, 16:9 aspect ratio, preferably 1920x1080. Medium: authentic handmade low-resolution pixel art, visible small square pixel clusters, approximately a 480x270 pixel design enlarged with hard edges, crisp staircase diagonals and restrained dithering. Muted dark purple, charcoal, dusty burgundy, faded teal, desaturated cream and rusty metal, 32-48 color feeling. Detailed environment art with strong readable silhouettes, matching an atmospheric grimy pixel game rather than realistic concept painting. Camera eye-level wide side-on with modest perspective. Lower 35 percent and lower-right should be darker and less busy because the game's inventory and scavenging panel overlay those areas; put the main identity and readable environmental detail in upper and middle portions. No player, no characters, no inventory, no UI, no frames, no typography, no readable words or numbers, no logo or watermark. No realistic photography, no smooth painted gradients, no vector shapes, no 3D render, no generic giant junk mountain.
Scene: the exclusive upper residential district's back-of-house service gallery just outside a private banquet hall. Curved brass-and-teal structural arches, intact cream wall panels and geometric luxury flooring contrast with worn maintenance pipes. Through a high frosted archway warm amber chandelier light and empty formal tables suggest a rich residents' celebration. In the service area stand discreet medical-delivery containers, catering carts with silver trays and neatly stacked reusable boxes. A potted plant and velvet curtain hint at privilege. Night, quiet, opulent but decaying space-station infrastructure; a few scuffed discarded parcels are scavengable. Compose as an expansive original location, not a copy of a trash dump.
